# whiteb0x — A Development Studio

> Full-stack engineering from web applications to blockchain protocols. We build software that matters.

## About

white b0x inc. is a development studio founded in 2022. We design and ship software — from production web applications to blockchain protocols. Our work covers Web2 and Web3, with a focus on engineering quality, visual precision, and production reliability.

## Services

- Full-stack web application development (Next.js, React, TypeScript)
- Blockchain protocol engineering and smart contract development
- UI/UX design and interactive 3D experiences (WebGL, Three.js)
- DevOps, infrastructure, and deployment

## Technology

- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4
- 3D/WebGL: React Three Fiber, custom GLSL shaders
- Blockchain: EVM-compatible chains, Solidity, Foundry
- Infrastructure: Node.js 24, Docker, Vercel

## Web Properties

- whiteb0x.com — This site (studio landing)
- github.com/white-b0x — Open source work and public repositories
